verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is self-hostable (Docker) and can run entirely locally with no data leaving the device, which lets a user choose exactly where data resides by controlling their own infrastructure; the hosted version also exists but with no documented region/residency selection controls. There's no explicit multi-region hosting feature or data-residency configuration for the managed/cloud offering. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection controls for the hosted service, compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR/data-residency certifications), and confirmation that self-hosting is the only mechanism to satisfy residency requirements.
